method: Second fresh internal holdout, authored after final role-alias correction and freeze. No references fed to decoder, no code tuning after this corpus. AI review, not independent human adjudication.

cases.source: Every convergent sequence is bounded, but boundedness alone does not guarantee convergence. The order of the implication matters.
The sample was weighed before the solvent was added. The reported mass therefore excludes the solvent rather than describing the final mixture.
The odds ratio is not the same as the risk ratio. They can differ substantially when the event is common.
A fall in marginal cost does not necessarily lower average cost immediately. The current production level matters for that comparison.
The instrument could distinguish the two signals only after averaging repeated measurements. This does not mean that either signal became stronger.
The committee postponed its decision because the evidence was incomplete. Postponement should not be interpreted as rejection of the hypothesis.
Nilai mutlak selisih kedua perkiraan lebih kecil dari 0.02. Pernyataan ini tidak menentukan perkiraan mana yang lebih besar.
Zat padat itu larut tanpa bereaksi dengan pelarut. Hilangnya bentuk padat tidak membuktikan terjadinya reaksi kimia.
Sampel yang lebih besar memperkecil galat acak tetapi tidak otomatis menghapus bias seleksi. Kedua sumber kesalahan perlu dibedakan.
Kenaikan pendapatan nominal belum tentu meningkatkan daya beli. Harga barang yang dibeli rumah tangga juga perlu diperhitungkan.
Pengamat tidak mengetahui kelompok perlakuan peserta saat menilai hasil. Penyembunyian informasi itu bertujuan mengurangi bias penilaian.
Asumsi independensi digunakan dalam penurunan rumus. Jika pengamatan saling bergantung, rumus tersebut memerlukan pembenaran tambahan.
